sources.title: OpenAI 推出具有更低 API 價格與部分基準測試提升的 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol / OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 推出具有更低 API 價格與部分基準測試提升的 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol
sources.title_en: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
sources.title_original: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
sources.summary: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, two new models that are more capable and cheaper than their predecessors. In the independent Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Astra ranks second behind Claude Fable 5.2, and it is the first released model to reach the High threshold for AI self-improvement on OpenAI's own scale. OpenAI itself classifies that as a risk. The article OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布了 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol，這兩款新模型比前代更具能力且價格更低。在獨立的「人工分析智慧指數」（Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index）中，Astra 名列 Claude Fable 5.2 之後位居第二，也是第一個在 OpenAI's 自己的量表上達到 AI 自我改進「高」門檻的發布模型。OpenAI 本身將其歸類為一種風險。

OpenAI itself classifies that as a risk. The article OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.title: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol，將 Astra 的標準價格降至每百萬輸入 Token 8 美元 / OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, cutting Astra's standard price to $8 per million input tokens
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol，將 Astra 的標準價格降至每百萬輸入 Token 8 美元
sources.title_en: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, cutting Astra's standard price to $8 per million input tokens
sources.title_original: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, cutting Astra's standard price to $8 per million input tokens
sources.summary: OpenAI published GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol on November 17th with API model IDs, Responses and Chat Completions support, and standard pricing of $8/$40 per million input/output tokens for Astra and $2/$10 for Sol.
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 11 月 17 日發布了 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 GPT-6.2 Sol，支援 API 模型 ID、回應與聊天完成功能，Astra 的標準定價為每百萬輸入/輸出 Token 8 美元/40 美元，Sol 則為 2 美元/10 美元。
